summary: Continued initial validation with expanded backend and UI coverage. Backend extended suite passed for RBAC, metrics attribution, manual sale assignment, station no_data/interrupted, ZIP content, and synthetic local reader behavior. Major production blocker found: browser-origin POST/PATCH/DELETE requests are rejected with 403 'Origem não autorizada', which blocks normal UI auth and all UI write actions.

critical.issue: Browser requests with Origin https://privacy-agent-hub.preview.emergentagent.com are rejected (403 Origem não autorizada). Reproduced on auth login and creator creation; blocks frontend auth and CRUD from real browser flow.

minor.issue: Intermittent assertion assumes no station connected (expects 409 before pairing) but environment can already have active station state, causing false failure.

ui_bugs.issue: Save action fails with 'Origem não autorizada.'

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by backend origin guard/CORS mismatch. Read-only navigation works using injected session cookie, but normal browser authentication and all write operations fail.

issues: Menu and dialog controls (help/alerts) opened/closed successfully

action_items: Fix runtime APP_ORIGIN/CORS alignment so browser Origin https://privacy-agent-hub.preview.emergentagent.com is accepted for POST/PATCH/DELETE.

After origin fix, re-run full UI flows: login, creators create/edit/search/filter/grid-list, team add/edit permissions, shift controls/corrections, quality review start/save, settings save, CSV actions.
Optionally harden phase1 station precondition test to be state-aware when a station is already connected in shared environments.
Keep synthetic test data for main-agent inspection now; clean up by deleting TEST2_* creators and chatter.*@example.com users after verification.
critical_code_review_comments: origin_guard enforces strict equality against ORIGIN for mutating methods; deployed ORIGIN/CORS appears mismatched versus public frontend origin, causing production browser write-path outage.
CORS preflight returned 'Disallowed CORS origin' for the public URL origin, corroborating browser integration breakage.
No Privacy API usage observed; local-agent reader remains synthetic/validated-only and does not invent selectors.

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14 in combined serial run; 1 state-precondition test failure)

rca of the issue: Reproduction: (1) Open public frontend URL and submit login with gestor.validacao@example.com / Vertice!Validacao2026 -> 403 Origem não autorizada. (2) Even with authenticated cookie, POST /creators from UI returns same error. (3) Browser fetch('/api/auth/login') returns 403. (4) OPTIONS preflight to /api/auth/login with origin https://privacy-agent-hub.preview.emergentagent.com returns 400 Disallowed CORS origin. Root cause is runtime origin validation/CORS mismatch between backend allowed origin and public frontend origin. Mitigation: correct runtime APP_ORIGIN (and CORS allow_origins) to exact deployed frontend origin, then retest all browser write paths.
